briefing: Stocks fell broadly today: the NASDAQ dropped 2.3% and the S&P 500 dropped 1.8%. Because the market is risk-off and no candidates passed the screen, I made no new buys and kept the $545.88 in cash. I'm holding all 7 positions so the automatic stop-losses and profit targets can do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, usually moving money into safer places like cash or bonds. Tech-heavy indexes such as the NASDAQ often fall the most on these days. Many disciplined investors hold off on new buys until conditions settle, instead of trying to catch a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨審慎，紛紛沽出成長股等高風險資產，並將資金轉向現金或債券等較穩健的資產。在這類交易日，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數往往跌幅最大。紀律嚴謹的投資者通常會暫停建立新倉，待市況回穩後才再部署，而不是急於在跌市中接貨。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks sold off broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ down 2.3% and the S&P 500 down 1.8%. The NASDAQ fell further than the S&P 500, which suggests investors were selling growth and technology stocks harder than the wider market, as they usually do when risk appetite drops. No news headlines were included in today's data, so this summary can't name a specific trigger and is based only on the index moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面受壓，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌2.3%，標普500指數亦下跌1.8%。納指跌幅大於標普，顯示資金對成長股及科技股的拋售較大市更為集中，這是市場風險胃納收縮時常見的情況。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，以上分析僅依據指數表現，未能指出具體的觸發因素。
